title: Conformal Cooling via 3D Printing: A Faster Path to Better Injection Molding
summary: Enabled by metal 3D printing, conformal cooling channels deliver more efficient heat transfer, faster cooling, and more uniform mold temperatures throughout the tool.
body_markdown:
These advanced cooling networks would be difficult or impossible to create with conventional machining. Metal 3D printing removes those design limitations, allowing engineers to optimize cooling channel placement for maximum performance rather than manufacturability.


For manufacturers producing high volumes, molding complex geometries, or struggling with part quality issues, conformal cooling provides a proven way to improve productivity, reduce costs, and deliver better parts. By leveraging metal additive manufacturing, moldmakers can unlock new levels of efficiency and profitability across their injection molding operations.
